milestone: M58 Bounded Autonomous Product Loop Drive

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Moves product-continuation route execution under headless.run.drive checkpoint authority so scheduled callers can drive existing M57 admission and run routes without owning route glue.
Lets the explicit loop consume one persisted product-continuation route boundary per bounded drive advance.
Keeps Rust responsible for route-boundary validation, target freshness, replay identity checks, and task.run delegation.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting agent_loop and runtime_permission_enforcement.
answers.new_capability: headless.run.drive can advance a persisted product-continuation admission or run route by forwarding an explicitly authorized bounded target through headless.run.advance into the existing M57 headless.continue_once route implementation.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M57 required caller-side choreography across route inspection, headless.continue_once admission, and headless.continue_once run. The drive RPC could not consume those product-continuation boundaries itself.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: The scheduled loop would still need external route glue for the product-continuation bridge and could not rely on drive checkpoints for replay-safe admission/run progress.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M57.1 admission and M57.2 run execution because this phase lifts those existing route steps into headless.run.drive rather than adding another product-continuation route.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive and headless.run.advance envelopes are extended; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase adds no report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, dashboard, or inspection surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime now validates persisted product-continuation route boundaries and replay request identity before forwarding one admission or one run target through the drive-controlled advance path.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless controller can continue product development with fewer caller-owned steps while preserving explicit authorization and deterministic drive replay.
answers.milestone_progress: Provides the first M58 vertical slice toward bounded product-loop driving after M57 established the underlying admission/run routes.

exit_criteria: headless.run.drive accepts exactly one explicit product-continuation admission or run target per bounded drive advance
the runtime rejects admission/run drive targets when the persisted session route boundary does not match
drive replay validates product-continuation request identity and rejects mismatched replay targets instead of returning a stale persisted result
the admitted continuation task is not run during the admission drive step
the run drive step delegates to existing task.run exactly once for the admitted continuation task
behavior tests cover admission drive success, replay without duplicate decision evidence, run drive execution, and mismatched replay denial
no new JSON-RPC method, report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, inspection, dashboard, provider expansion, workspace mutation expansion, or VSIX-owned policy is introduced

ledger and RPC outputs exclude raw prompts, provider responses, file content, diffs, stdout/stderr, commands, environment values, raw requests, raw ledger payloads, absolute paths, canonical paths, tokens, and secrets

behavior_evidence: drive-level admission and run behavior test
safety_boundary: requires explicit product-continuation admission or run target
requires matching persisted headless run route boundary
delegates run execution only to existing task.run authority
stores bounded identifiers and SHA-256 fingerprints only
non_goals: no unbounded loop or background scheduler
rejected_alternatives: leaving M57 two-call choreography as caller responsibility
adding a product-continuation drive readiness report
auto-running immediately after admission without an explicit run target
moving route policy into the VSIX
technical_debt: The runtime file remains large; extraction should remain a later behavior-preserving refactor.
This phase drives one product-continuation route step per drive call rather than a full unbounded product loop.
next_capability_rationale: A future M58 phase can derive the next product-continuation drive target from persisted drive evidence if it remains bounded and behavior-changing.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M58.1 updates the current and archived phase-value manifests for a runtime behavior phase. Review must confirm guard enforcement is not weakened and no wrapper/report/readiness surface was added.
